test_first.reason: Validated private-pack bindings and runner source-closure metadata were absent from the child contract.
A nested directory symlink was invisible to the Python-only glob; the corrected regression first removed an accidental empty-member false positive.
PATH, locale, Python, loader and transport execution-control names were accepted as credential variables.
Unchecked bytecode and native import artifacts under declared Python roots were not rejected or hashed.
Ambient PATH drift could change child execution after approval; an os.defpath-only repair then selected the host system Python instead of the locked environment.
The python3 entry selected by the deterministic child PATH could be retargeted independently from sys.executable without changing the environment hash.

final.independent_review: APPROVE for this bounded local admission-hardening package

limitations: Trusted-local operator boundary; no cryptographic same-user race protection is claimed.

No owner review, human approval, production benchmark, request/non-transfer proof or baseline seal is represented.
